dialogues.speaker: Roshchina
dialogues.text: It's already this late... why hasn't he shown up yet?

dialogues.speaker: Roshchina
dialogues.text: My prince, my fate, my one and only — the always so serious, so dutiful man...

dialogues.speaker: Roshchina
dialogues.text: My mysterious lover who tests my sincerity by being too busy with work... the one I think of day and night, the one I cannot forget...

dialogues.speaker: Roshchina
dialogues.text: He always passes this bridge after work. If I just buy a ticket and stand here every day, someday... he'll come to me.

dialogues.speaker: Roshchina
dialogues.text: Just like the past seventeen times — he always walks right past me with his head down, pretending not to notice me... how adorable he is.

dialogues.speaker: Roshchina
dialogues.text: He will come. He absolutely will. He will...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Is it possible he doesn't work here anymore?

dialogues.speaker: Roshchina
dialogues.text: Not here anymore? No, that can't be. Why would he be avoiding me? I love him so much...

dialogues.speaker: Roshchina
dialogues.text: He told me himself, "Let's talk another time." He promised me! This is where we first met — he would never lie to me...

dialogues.speaker: Roshchina
dialogues.text: ...Yes. He's just working overtime. He'll be here any moment now...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh... I hope you get to see him soon.

dialogues.speaker: Roshchina
dialogues.text: Hehe... I will. I'll definitely see him again... Even if I wait until the theater closes... even if it's tomorrow, or the day after... I'll keep waiting...
